title: Where Is the Tradeoff in Using Third-Party API Routers for Agentic Software Development?
abstract: arXiv:2607.23624v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Third-party API routers have become a common layer that unifies access across increasingly diverse LLM providers. In coding-agent workflows, high-autonomy operation is widely adopted because it reduces interaction overhead. As a result, a third-party API router, which sits between the agent and the upstream provider, inevitably occupies the trusted path. It can inspect and modify every request and response, yet no mechanism verifies alignment between the provider's output and the repository-level actions ultimately executed by the agent. Consequently, client-side permission mechanisms may become ineffective in practice. Whether this control gap produces real, hard-to-detect effects on software development tasks remains empirically unmeasured. translated_title: 在智能体软件开发中使用第三方API路由器的权衡在哪里？
translated_abstract: 第三方API路由器已成为一种常见的中间层，统一了对日益多样化的LLM提供商的访问。在编码智能体工作流中，高自主性操作被广泛采用，因为它减少了交互开销。因此，位于智能体与上游提供商之间的第三方API路由器不可避免地占据了可信路径。它可以检查和修改每一个请求与响应，然而目前没有任何机制来验证提供商的输出与智能体最终执行的仓库级操作之间的一致性。因此，客户端权限机制在实践中可能变得无效。这种控制缺口是否会对软件开发任务产生真实的、难以检测的影响，此前尚未得到实证测量。在本文中，我们对编码智能体中的路由器端注入进行了实证研究，考察了四个隐蔽程度递增的干预级别：响应替换（L1）、响应追加……
tldr: 该论文首次实证研究了编码智能体中第三方API路由器的路由器端注入风险，通过四个隐蔽程度递增的干预级别（如响应替换）揭示其可对软件开发任务造成真实且难以检测的影响，而现有客户端权限机制难以有效防御。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first empirical study of router-side injection in coding agents, demonstrating through four increasingly subtle intervention levels (e.g., response substitution) that third-party API routers can cause real, hard-to-detect effects on software development tasks while existing client-side permission mechanisms fail to prevent them.
